facts.summary: Announced underwritten public offering of stock, pre-funded and common warrants at discount · Preclinical · psychedelic and cannabinoid candidates in cancer-related distress · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The public offering price per share of common stock, the public offering price per Pre-Funded Warrant and the public offering price per Common Warrant will be determined between us, the underwriter, and investors based on market conditions at the time of pricing, and may be at a discount to the current market price of our shares of common stock.
